facts.text: The King Commitment Scholarship guarantees full tuition for four years to Tennessee students who are eligible for both Pell and TN HOPE.

sources.title: Scholarships and Grants | King University
sources.quote: For Tennessee students who are Pell-eligible and TN HOPE-eligible, King guarantees full tuition is covered for four years — a last-dollar award on top of every other scholarship and grant you receive.
